enabled.description: Repo-level kill switch; false stops every run.

maintainers.description: GitHub logins: B4 questions, assignments, pings, allowed command authors.

setup.description: How an agent installs the project in its sandbox.

test.description: B2 repro and B5 exit condition.

allowed_domains.description: Egress allowlist for agents that run project commands (B2, B5): the package registries `setup` and `test` need, e.g. pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, registry.npmjs.org (ADR-0037). Empty: no network.

triage_per_author_per_day.description: B1 runs per outside author (not in maintainers) in a rolling 24 hours; 0 = never auto-triage outsiders (ADR-0058).

triage_per_day.description: B1 runs for all outside authors together in a rolling 24 hours; 0 = never auto-triage outsiders (ADR-0058).

reporter_silence_days.description: Days from the B2 request for details to the ping, the stale label and the close (spec: Reporter silence). Decimals allowed, so a test config can use minutes; actions/stale rounds close - stale down to whole days.

notify.description: Chat channels for notifications; both may be set together. Keep in sync with aiwf.notify.parse_channels (tests/test_config.py).

linked_issue.description: issue-or-plan-ref: a WP id or docs/plan.md reference in the PR text also counts as a linked issue, and a WP PR (branch wp<N>-...) needs e2e run IDs in its description (ADR-0053).

model.description: Optional Claude model override for agent runs.

required_checks.description: Optional: check names the CI gate waits for; default is all checks on the head SHA except ours.
